checklist.desc: All specs and limits: product weight, child weight/height limits, folded and open dimensions, box contents, warranty (manual + any spec source).
Complete fold procedure from manual pages 33-35, one STEP claim per action, with thumb switch and handle lever as PART_LOCATION claims bound to manual diagrams.
All safety warnings in the manual, each a WARNING claim at C3.
Harness procedures: securing child (5-point), 5-point to 3-point conversion, harness height adjustment. Added 2026-08-24 under the procedures-are-never-skippable policy.
Footrest adjustment and cup holder attachment/use. Added 2026-08-24 under the procedures-are-never-skippable policy.

revision_note: max raised on 2026-08-24: procedures-are-never-skippable policy — deferred procedures (harness height / footrest, cup holder, 3-point conversion) must be extracted; band ceiling must never cause omission.
